pages.text: The $(item)Chemical Vat$() is the mod's all-purpose reactor: it mixes, cracks, freezes, compresses and runs electrolysis. There are three kinds, and each recipe lists the kinds it accepts:
$(li)$(item)Cast Iron Chemical Vat$(): the cheapest. Most mixing and freezing recipes accept it.$(li)$(item)Steel Chemical Vat$(): needed for pressure work and electrolysis.
$(li)$(item)Fireproof Chemical Vat$() (firebrick-lined): accepts everything, and is the only one the $(item)arc furnace$() works in. Its windows cannot be opened.

$(l)Building bigger$()$(br)Vats of the same kind join like Create fluid tanks: up to $(item)3x3 wide$() and up to $(item)10 blocks high$(). Some recipes ask for a $(item)minimum size$() in blocks (width x width x height).

Each vat has $(item)4 input$() and $(item)4 output$() fluid tanks, each holding $(item)8 buckets per block$() with Create's default tank size, plus $(item)4 input$() and $(item)4 output$() item slots. Each item slot holds a different item.$(br2)Hit a vat with a $(item)wrench$() to open or close its windows.
